learning_outcomes.text: Explain in simple words what artificial intelligence is
Give examples of AI used in everyday life
Explain that AI learns from examples (data) rather than being told every rule
Describe the difference between a human and a computer 'thinking'
Recognise that AI can make mistakes and is not always right
Discuss simple, fair and kind uses of AI

integrative_case: The class investigates everyday AI: they list AI they have used, 'train' a paper AI to sort animal pictures from examples, discover it makes a mistake with a tricky picture, and agree one fair classroom rule for using AI helpers.
